label: people
name: People Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR people image into one or more detailed categories based on the subjects, framing, age group, activity, event, and environment shown.

labels.portrait: A photo primarily showing one person's face or upper body posed as a portrait.
labels.selfie: A self-taken photo showing a person looking toward a nearby phone or camera.
labels.close_up: A photo where a person's face or a body detail fills most of the image frame.
labels.full_body: A photo showing a person from head to toe with most of the entire body visible.
labels.group: A photo primarily showing several people together in the same scene.
labels.family: A photo showing family members together, such as parents, children, or relatives.
labels.couple: A photo primarily showing two people together as a pair or romantic couple.
labels.crowd: A photo showing a large number of people gathered closely in a public place or event.
labels.man: A photo clearly showing one or more adult men as the primary subjects.
labels.woman: A photo clearly showing one or more adult women as the primary subjects.
labels.child: A photo clearly showing one or more young children as the primary subjects.
labels.baby: A photo clearly showing an infant or baby as the primary subject.
labels.teenager: A photo clearly showing an adolescent or teenage person as the primary subject.
labels.adult: A photo clearly showing an adult person when no more specific age group is evident.
labels.elderly_person: A photo clearly showing an older or elderly person as the primary subject.
labels.wedding: A photo showing a wedding ceremony, bride and groom, wedding clothing, or wedding celebration.
labels.party: A photo showing people at a social party with celebration, decorations, dancing, or gathering.
labels.birthday: A photo showing a birthday celebration, birthday cake, candles, gifts, or birthday decorations.
labels.sports: A photo showing people playing, training for, or participating in a sport.
labels.work: A photo showing people performing professional, office, industrial, agricultural, or manual work.
labels.travel: A photo showing people traveling, sightseeing, carrying luggage, or visiting a destination.
labels.graduation: A photo showing a graduation ceremony, academic gowns, diplomas, or graduating students.
labels.performance: A photo showing a person singing, dancing, acting, speaking, or performing for an audience.
labels.meeting: A photo showing people participating in a business meeting, discussion, conference, or collaboration.
labels.outdoor: A photo showing people primarily in an outdoor environment under open sky.
labels.indoor: A photo showing people primarily inside a room, building, or enclosed space.
